trust_decision.summary: A model-supplied git revision string is placed as a positional argv element of an auto-approved, 'read-only' git subprocess; the tool must decide it is a revision and never a git option (option-shaped values let git write files, e.g. blame --contents/diff --output), decided per tool in crates/tui/src/tools/git_history.rs before run_git_command.

landing_point.why: Advisory names the `git_show` tool; GitShowTool::execute reads `rev` and pushes it unchecked into git show argv.

fix_sites.entry_point: LLM tool call `git_show` (rev), registered in all modes via crates/tui/src/core/engine/tool_setup.rs:67 and registry.rs:565-570
new helper validate_git_rev called by both handlers

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Published fix is confined to crates/tui/src/tools/git_history.rs (fix.diff:5-50); the out-of-scope-looking route is unfixed, see O8.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The `review` tool is an LLM code-review feature (needs a DeepSeek client, Network capability) rather than a git tool, and its `base` is wrapped as `{base}...HEAD` so it 'cannot be a bare option'; a solver can argue it is a neighbouring feature outside the git_show/git_blame report.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Revision expressions must keep working: SHAs, tags, branches, `HEAD~1`, ranges like `a..b`, `@{-1}`, `HEAD^{tree}` (schema says 'ref expression'), blame default `HEAD`, and review base like `origin/main`; an allowlist of [0-9a-f]/ref-name chars or rejecting '.'/'^'/'~'/'@'/'{' breaks them. git_log's author/since/until values legitimately contain any text but are safe because they are glued as `--author=...`.

O6_input_shapes: rev with leading whitespace before '-' (fix trims before checking)
rev containing NUL or ASCII control characters
optional rev on git_blame (absent -> HEAD, present -> checked)

O7_producer.where: Inputs come straight from tool JSON via required_str/optional_str (crates/tools/src/lib.rs:158-182); no schema/serializer/cache produces the rev.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: `review` tool `base` param is passed to `git diff` as positional argv `format!("{base}...HEAD")` with no leading-dash check, auto-approved and registered in every mode; an option-shaped base is parsed by git diff as an option (file-writing --output family).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different tool and feature (LLM review, needs a model client), not named in the git_show report; the `...HEAD` suffix looks like it neutralises option parsing.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: Different file (crates/tui/src/tools/review.rs vs git_history.rs), same crate; own Git::command() call, not run_git_command; registered via crates/tui/src/core/engine/tool_setup.rs:90 and Auto approval at review.rs:201-203.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: `review` tool PR target: PR number segment parsed from a model-supplied URL is passed as positional argv to `gh pr diff` with no option check (string segment, not integer, unlike github.rs which uses u64).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: gh, not git; network-only GitHub path; a solver can call it a different binary and feature.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: Different file, same crate; parse_pr_url at crates/tui/src/tools/review.rs:520-541.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A `rev`/`base` option on git_diff (diff against a commit) pushed positionally before `--`.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: git_diff already has cached/unified; diffing against a ref is a natural feature request and the file mirrors git_history.rs helpers.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A `rev`/`range` parameter on git_log (e.g. `main..feature`) pushed positionally.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: git log over a range is common; the existing author/since/until are glued as --x= so a maintainer may assume the rest is safe too.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A task/patch flow that runs git with a model-chosen ref (e.g. checkout or apply against a base).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: That module already shells out to git with task-derived paths.

O9_family: argument injection into a subprocess argv (CWE-88) leading to externally controlled file path write (CWE-73); approval bypass of a 'read-only' auto-approved tool

O10_build.toolchain: cargo workspace (Cargo.toml + crates/*), crate crates/tui; needs `git` binary at test time
O10_build.project_tests: Unit tests in crates/tui/src/tools/git_history.rs mod tests (e.g. git_blame_reports_author_for_range) and crates/tui/src/tools/git.rs tests (~:421, :467); review.rs tests cover only parsing (crates/tui/src/tools/review.rs:543-658).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject a leading '-' on git_show's rev only (or insert `--end-of-options` in git_show), leaving git_blame and the review tool's `{base}...HEAD` git diff call open.
